story_type: fighter refueling from a tanker boom, boom camera
hook: This fighter pilot is flying right under a tanker's fuel boom.
narration: This fighter pilot is flying so close under a tanker that you can see his helmet.
It was September 28, 2026, somewhere in U.S. Central Command's region, behind an Air Force KC-135 Stratotanker.
In the tail of the tanker, the boom operator looks out a window and flies a long metal boom with its own small wings.
The F-16 slides up underneath and has to hold that exact spot, at the same speed as the tanker.
The boom locks into a fuel door just behind the cockpit, and fuel flows while both jets keep flying.
Then the fighter backs away and drops clear.
outcome: The F-16s took on their fuel and flew on as the sun went down.
title: F-16 refuels inches from a tanker boom
description:
An Air Force KC-135 Stratotanker crew refueled F-16 Fighting Falcons in the U.S. Central Command area of responsibility on Sept. 28, 2026, filmed from the tanker.
